author: jalmena
tagline: Your sacred repository of guitar tabs
description:
A self-hosted guitar songbook. Your songs are plain .song text files in a directory you own — back them up, edit them by hand, put them in git. The database is only an index and can be deleted at any time; it rebuilds from the files.

Transpose a sheet and the tablature moves with it. Click any chord to see how it is held, with alternative shapes. Open the Chords section to draw a shape on a fretboard and be told what chord it is, or name a chord and see every way of playing it, easiest first. Print a real A4 sheet, or pick any set of songs and print them as one songbook.

Press Play and the sheet scrolls itself, big enough to read from a stand, so your hands can stay on the guitar. A song full of barre chords is told where to put a capo so it is not: same sound, easier shapes. Draw a shape on the fretboard and hear it, on nylon, steel or a distorted electric, and be told how hard it is to hold.

Write a song a section at a time, with every chord floating above its syllable: press above a word to put one there, drag it to move it, press it to change it. Or bring the song as you have it, with the chords on the line above the words: paste it, load it, or import a folder of them at once, and it is read into sections for you to check. Join, split and move sections from the keyboard.

Reading needs no account. Changing anything does, once you have made one. Nineteen interface languages, note names as C-D-E or Do-Re-Mi, and a light or dark theme, all chosen per person.

Works offline, sends nothing anywhere, has no telemetry. Tabernacle manages music you provide; it does not supply, license or distribute any musical work, and it does not download anything from anywhere.

tips.before_install:
Set PUID and PGID to the owner of /DATA/AppData/tabernacle/data, or the container may not be able to write to it. On the host, `id -u` and `id -g` will tell you.

Put your .song files in data/songs as Artist/Title.song, or import them from the web interface. Reading needs no account; press Sign in to claim the instance and create the first administrator.

title: Tabernacle
release_note: Chords sit above the words in the editor: press above a syllable to put one there, drag it to move it, press it to change it. The key and the tuning are chosen from a list, the artist and the genre offer what the collection has, and leaving with changes not yet saved asks first.
